name: Costco Kirkland Deli Ground Beef & Rice Stuffed Bell Peppers (Eat Filling Only Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Costco Wholesale Deli (Logan / Lehi / South Jordan / Sandy, UT)
whyItWorks: The interior filling of seasoned ground beef, tender white rice, and melted mozzarella/parmesan cheese is soft and high in protein once you scoop it out of the fibrous bell pepper shell.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake until piping hot, then scoop out and eat the seasoned beef-and-rice interior while leaving the tough outer bell pepper skin on the plate.
watchOuts: Bell pepper skins are insoluble nightshade fiber that resists digestion—eat the beef and rice filling only
